status: draft for the owner's edit (slice (f) lane, 2026-09-06)
artist_scope: none (Tier 3: no motion; the pose is which cubes are visible)
character_sheet: A mineable rock disguised as a creature. On its first tick it rolls a type (twelve of them: plain, small, coloured, spiky, TNT and four crystal kinds; the Crystal dimension forces the crystal types), shows the cube set for that type, and sits there with a fixed yaw until it is broken for its drops. It never moves and never turns.
size_notes: 0.25 x 0.15 block hitbox at x1, no shadow; the visible rock is larger than the hitbox.
formulas: No rotation channels. Visibility by rock type (ModelRockBase.java:180-230; RockBaseGeoReplacement.java:46-83): type 1 -> the two RockSmall pieces; 7 -> the three RockSpikey pieces; 8 -> the four RockTNT pieces; 9-12 -> the ten Crystal pieces; every other type 2-6 -> the three Rock pieces; type 0 -> nothing.
Texture by type (RockBaseRenderer.textureFor:56-69): 3 red, 4 green, 5 blue, 6 purple, 8 TNT, 9 crystal, 10 crystal green, 11 crystal blue, 12 crystal TNT, otherwise rocktexture.

`ModelRockBase.poseFrom` (ModelRockBase.java:186-221, called from `setupAnim` :180-184; orig ModelRockBase.java:177-222, `render`, draws the type's parts directly): every part hidden, then the type's parts shown — no angle is ever written, so the reference clip holds one key at bind and the visible set is the sentence above; the entity zeroes its own rotation every tick (RockBase.tick).
behaviour: Static: the entity zeroes its own rotation every tick (RockBase.tick).
